sidebar.title: Player Facing Rules
sidebar.p: In a Player-Facing rules system the Players make all the dice rolls, when a goblin attacks a PC, the goblin does not roll to hit, instead the PC rolls to defend. This approach has the following perceived benefits:

descriptions.description: Player Facing rules push work from the GM to the players, reducing the GM's workload allows them to concentrate on other aspects of the game.
By making the rolls players feel that fate is in their hands.
When players roll it feels less like they are competing against the GM.
